natural_body: 40% discounts raise acquisition and revenue but hurt retention and renewals.

first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and two prior results indicate simplification can improve completion, time-to-value, and first-week activation. This directly targets both current problems without the known retention risk of deep discounting. Verify downstream retention and qualified-revenue effects before committing, since the summaries primarily establish early-funnel gains.
